description: Use only once the customer has decided to buy ("I'll take it", "how do I buy?"): the checkout handoff. Returns the buy_url to give the customer, the final price and a ready-to-send checkout block (next_step, payment_methods, delivery) — on the page they press "Get it" and pay securely. No account needed; the eSIM is delivered on screen and by e-mail right after payment. No in-chat order tracking, no discount codes. For prices while the customer is still comparing, use quote_esim.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. en-gb, de-de (sets currency and link locale). Defaults from language.

destination.description: Country in ANY language or its ISO code, e.g. "Japan", "Japon", "jp". Map a city to its country first. One country per eSIM.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Localizes country names and sets the language/currency of links and prices.

networks.description: Optional: operator names (or codes) from get_networks to include. Omit = the cheapest network of the country. The dearest included network sets the data price and every network beyond the first adds a small fee.

name: start_checkout

buy_url.description: Configurator pre-set to exactly this configuration. Use verbatim.

data_gb.description: Total data pool for the whole validity (GB). Not per day.

days.description: Validity in days, counted from the first connection at the destination.

delivery.description: How and when the eSIM arrives.

message.description: A ready-to-send line for the customer.

networks.description: Operator names included in this eSIM.

next_step.description: What the customer does now: open buy_url, press "Get it", pay.

price.description: FULL price of this configuration in currency — the amount paid. Not per day, not per GB.

title: Start secure checkout
